limits.en: Full open source library (MIT), no artificial limits on workers/concurrency

keyLimits.en: Node.js and Bun only; grouping, batches, observables, professional support

cautions.en: The core BullMQ library is free and open source; BullMQ Pro is a separate paid commercial add-on ($139/month or $1,395/year) for advanced features and support.

capabilities.en: Redis-backed job queues for Node.js (and Bun, with Python/Rust/Elixir/PHP clients) with workers, delayed jobs, and rate limiting
Recurring job schedulers using cron expressions or fixed intervals, plus job flows with parent-child relationships
Auto-retry with exponential backoff and event monitoring

limitations.en: Advanced features like job grouping, batching, and RxJS observables require the paid BullMQ Pro tier
Requires a self-managed Redis instance; BullMQ itself is a library, not a hosted service

unknowns: BullMQ Pro Enterprise and Embedded plan pricing are on quote only, not published publicly.
